resultPromise.message: “{match}” promises a result you can't promise. How a treatment turns out depends on the person.
resultPromise.fix: Describe what the treatment does, and end with “Results vary per person.”

prescriptionName.message: “{match}” is a prescription-only medicine, and those may not be advertised to the public by name.
prescriptionName.fix: Use the name of the treatment instead — what the client books, not what is in it.

free.message: “{match}” can only describe something that costs the client nothing. Rewards are paid for with points.
free.conditionalMessage: “{match}” here depends on buying something else, so it isn't free.
free.fix: Say what it costs, or what it costs in points — “included with”, “250 points”.

urgencyWithoutDate.message: “{match}” tells clients to hurry, but this offer has no end date for them to hurry towards.
urgencyWithoutDate.fix: Set the offer's end date, then say it: “until 31 Oct”.

resultsVary.message: This talks about results without saying they differ from person to person.
resultsVary.fix: Add “Results vary per person.” at the end.
